title: A TBK1/ULK1 signalling axis couples lysosomal stress to TFEB activation
title_zh: TBK1/ULK1信号轴耦合溶酶体应激至TFEB激活
abstract: Lysosomal adaptation to environmental changes is critical for cellular and metabolic homeostasis and requires coordination by the mTORC1 kinase, which conveys nutritional and stress signals into distinct, substrate-specific outputs1,2. The FLCN–FNIP complex (FLCN:FNIP) serves as a crucial regulator of lysosomal function by selectively controlling the ability of mTORC1 to inhibit transcription factor EB (TFEB), a master regulator of catabolic programs and a known oncogene3. Yet how FLCN:FNIP activity is regulated has remained unclear. Here we identify a nutrient-independent lysosomal signalling pathway that regulates FLCN through v-ATPase-driven recruitment of TBK1 or ULK1 (TBK1/ULK1) to lysosomes, via the TAX1BP1 adaptor. This enables TBK1/ULK1-mediated FNIP1 phosphorylation at S296, resulting in inhibition of FLCN and nuclear translocation of TFEB. Recurrent ATP6V1B2 v-ATPase mutations, found in patients with follicular lymphoma, constitutively activate this pathway, leading to hyperactivation of TFEB and follicular lymphoma proliferation. Our work uncovers a lysosomal signalling pathway that is critical for lysosomal adaptation and tumorigenesis. Proteomic and phosphoproteomic analyses of lysosomes identify a nutrient-independent regulatory arm of mTORC1 signalling that mediates lysosomal adaptation to stress and whose deregulation underlies tumorigenesis in follicular lymphoma.
abstract_zh: 溶酶体适应环境变化对细胞和代谢稳态至关重要，需要mTORC1激酶协调，该激酶将营养和应激信号转化为特定的底物输出1,2。FLCN–FNIP复合物（FLCN:FNIP）作为溶酶体功能的关键调节因子，通过选择性控制mTORC1抑制转录因子EB（TFEB）的能力，TFEB是献献计划性程序的主调节因子且已知是一个致癌基因3。然而，FLCN:FNIP活性的调节机制此前尚不清楚。本研究鉴定了一个与营养无关的溶酶体信号通路，该通路通过v-ATPase驱动的TBK1或ULK1（TBK1/ULK1）招募至溶酶体，经TAX1BP1适配器调节。这使得TBK1/ULK1介导的FNIP1在S296位点磷酸化，从而抑制FLCN并促进TFEB核转位。在follicular lymphoma（follicular淋巴瘤）患者中反复发现的ATP6V1B2 v-ATPase突变，可持续激活该通路，导致TFEB超激活和follicular lymphoma细胞增殖。本研究揭示了一个对溶酶体适应和肿瘤发生至关重要的溶酶体信号通路。溶酶体的蛋白质组和磷蛋白质组分析鉴定出mTORC1信号的一个与营养无关的调节臂，该臂介导溶酶体对应激的适应，其失调导致follicular lymphoma的肿瘤发生。
